The '''skeleton''' is an attackable NPC that can be found randomly on [[Uncharted Isles]]. They may be killed for combat experience and [[chimes]]. While not aggressive, they are accurate and can hit hard if players are unprepared for combat. The skeletons are usually found in small groups making it very dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks or abilities against them.

Attacking the skeletons will scale their [[life points]] and combative abilities to the player's own combat level. The stats and experience values shown to the right correspond to the monster at the maximum level.

The skeletons will always be found near an overturned cauldron with [[Potions (Uncharted Isles)|potions]] lying about; this acts as their respawn point.

During [[Final Destination (miniquest)]], the player encounters skeletons that are similar to those found on Uncharted Isles, however they grant no experience.
